entries.name: Seated Cable Rows
entries.reason: Redrawn on 9 October 2026 at the owner's request, because the earlier drawing was against this text: no seat was drawn and the legs ran steeply down to the foot plate. Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 35 degrees so the two hands on one V-handle show: sitting upright on the seat of a low row station with the feet on the plate and the knees slightly bent, arms straight; the trunk and legs do not move while the handle is pulled to the stomach with the arms close to the body and the elbows passing back beside the ribs, a squeeze, and a slower return to straight arms.
entries.summary: Seated upright at a low cable row with the feet on the plate, pull the V-handle to the stomach with the arms close to the body, squeeze, then let it return slowly to straight arms.

frames.caption: Sit at a low cable row station with the feet on the foot plate and the knees slightly bent, hold the V-handle and sit upright with the arms straight and the chest up.
Keeping the torso still and the arms close to the body, pull the handle to the stomach.
Squeeze the back. Drive the elbows back past the ribs.
Let the handle return slowly until the arms are straight.
